title: Sum of Subarray Minimums
description:
Given an array of integers `arr`, find the sum of `min(b)` over every non-empty contiguous subarray `b` of `arr`.

Since the total sum can be very large, return the answer modulo `10^9 + 7`.
hints: Instead of enumerating every subarray, count how many subarrays have `arr[i]` as their minimum and add `arr[i] * count`.

To avoid double-counting when duplicate values exist, break ties consistently: find the nearest strictly smaller element to the left (`<`) and the nearest smaller-or-equal element to the right (`<=`).

A single pass with a monotonic increasing stack computes both boundaries simultaneously: when index `mid` is popped by a smaller-or-equal element at `i`, `mid` spans `(mid - left) * (i - mid)` subarrays.

examples.explanation: Summing the minimum across all 15 contiguous subarrays gives 444.
All 6 contiguous subarrays have minimum 1, so the sum is 6.
